games.name: 🌾 Village & Mount Pamali
games.desc:
⛰️ Mount Horror - A mountain that must not be crossed ⛰️ 
Not an ordinary climb. Fog, forests, and deserted trails hide forgotten prohibitions. Every step can be an invitation for those waiting in the dark. Wear headphones. Don't climb alone if you're not mentally prepared.

🎮 Main Gameplay Features 
→ 🌲 Horror mountain trail, checkpoint to the summit 
→ 🔦 Darkness, flashlight, stamina & water need to be managed 
→ 👻 Jump scares and chases: pocong, kunti, and other ghosts 
→ 🙏 Sasajen missions, rituals, and puzzles on the path 
→ 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Friend mode: carrying the exhausted or "in the mood" 
→ 🏃‍♀️ Sprint when you need to flee - the atmosphere can change at any moment 

🙏 Keep supporting so that this project can grow and become more popular in the future.
